note: V61B fight-end camera (CameraDeath.cs, called from CameraRig.LateUpdate). After a plain death or after a finisher releases the camera, the look-at stays on the DEAD fighter's body (SkinnedMeshRenderer bounds). distances in metres, height / lookHeight above the body's lowest point x victim scale. enabled=false = the old free-camera pose.
_deathcam: DEATHCAM v1: no zoom in at a boss death. The death camera is never closer than minDistFightFrac x the fight camera distance and never lower than minHeightFightFrac x its height; keepFightCam=true or enabled=false = the fight camera only. Revert = apply_deathcam.py --off.
